recipes.name: Anima Edit (LoRA)
recipes.description: Requires a matching community editing LoRA. Apply it after loading and supply reference images; uses the cosmos_reference preset.

recipes.name: Anima
recipes.description: Supports all Anima variants supported by sd.cpp. Use a compatible Qwen Image VAE or TAE; adjust generation settings for distilled variants.

recipes.name: Boogu Image Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images. The separate vision projector is needed only when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Chroma Radiance
recipes.description: Pixel-space generation without a VAE. Also accepts the x0 and experimental patch-32 variants.

recipes.name: CosXL Edit
recipes.description: Supply the image to edit as a reference image.

recipes.name: Fibo 2.0 Dev
recipes.description: Text-to-image generation and native reference-image editing. Select a separate vision projector for editing when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo
recipes.description: Dedicated reference-image editing checkpoint; supply reference images. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Canny dev
recipes.description: Select Canny weights and supply a precomputed edge map as Control Image. Edge detection is not performed by this recipe.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Depth dev
recipes.description: Select Depth weights and supply a precomputed depth map as Control Image. Depth estimation is not performed by this recipe.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 dev
recipes.description: Supports FLUX.1 dev and compatible layer-count variants such as FLUX.1 Lite. Select the transformer with matching CLIP-L, T5XXL and FLUX.1 VAE.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Fill dev
recipes.description: Select Fill weights and supply Init Image plus Mask Image for inpainting. Denoising strength defaults to 1 for a full denoising schedule.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 Kontext dev
recipes.description: Select FLUX.1 Kontext weights. Supports text-to-image and native reference-image editing; an editing LoRA is not required.

recipes.name: FLUX.1 dev PuLID
recipes.description: Supply a precomputed PuLID identity embedding with the generation request.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 dev
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein 4B
recipes.description: Supports reference-image editing. The FLUX.2 small decoder is an alternative VAE.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein Base 4B
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.2 Klein Base 9B
recipes.description: Use the 9B base transformer with Qwen 3 8B. Supports reference-image editing.

recipes.name: FLUX.3 Image Klein
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing.

recipes.name: HiDream O1 Image dev
recipes.description: Bundled checkpoint; also supports reference-image editing.

recipes.name: Ideogram 4
recipes.description: Select the matching unconditional transformer for classifier-free guidance.

recipes.name: Instruct-Pix2Pix
recipes.description: Supply the image to edit as a reference image.

recipes.name: Iris 3B
recipes.description: Pixel-space model; no VAE is required.

recipes.name: Krea 2 Raw Edit (LoRA)

recipes.name: Krea 2 Raw

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: Krea 2 Turbo
recipes.description: For reference-image editing with a community LoRA, use the corresponding Krea 2 Edit recipe.

recipes.name: LLaDA Image Turbo
recipes.description: Use matching turbo text encoder and connectors. Editing needs connectors that include the SigVQ encoder.

recipes.name: LLaDA Image (base)
recipes.description: Use matching base transformer, text encoder and connectors; do not mix them with Turbo components. Editing needs connectors with SigVQ and 1024x1024 output.

recipes.name: LongCat Image Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images for editing.

recipes.name: Mage Flow Edit
recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a separate vision projector when it is not bundled in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required for separate GGUF text encoders)

recipes.name: MiniT2I
recipes.description: Pixel-space model; no VAE is required.

recipes.name: MOSS Image Base
recipes.description: Select the MOSS-Image-Base transformer with its matching text encoder and FLUX.2 VAE or TAE.

recipes.name: MOSS Image SFT
recipes.description: Select the MOSS-Image-SFT transformer with its matching text encoder and FLUX.2 VAE or TAE.

recipes.name: P-H3-Image
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and reference-image editing with the fixed 8-step schedule. Use the P-H3 single-frame VAE and Qwen3-VL-4B with its vision tower. Supply the P-H3 text connector separately unless it is included in the text encoder.

slots.label: Vision projector (required when not included in the text encoder)

recipes.name: PiD (Qwen Image VAE)

recipes.name: PiD (SD3 VAE)

recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a vision projector for GGUF text encoders; omit it if vision weights are included in the text encoder.

recipes.description: Supply reference images. Select a vision projector for GGUF text encoders; omit it if vision weights are included in the text encoder.

recipes.name: Qwen Image Layered
recipes.description: Supply a reference image and use the dedicated layered VAE.

recipes.name: Qwen Image
recipes.description: Supports text-to-image and image-to-image; pruned transformer variants use the same components.

recipes.name: SD Turbo
recipes.description: Select a single-file SD-Turbo checkpoint. Uses one step with CFG disabled (scale 1 in sd.cpp); use more steps for partial image-to-image denoising.

recipes.name: SD 1.x
recipes.description: Supports SD 1.x, compatible LCM checkpoints and layer-count variants. For LCM weights, select LCM sampling and adjust steps/CFG. Tiny SD Diffusers directories must first be converted into a single-file checkpoint.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 ControlNet
recipes.description: Supply a control image; input image and mask are optional for image-to-image or inpainting.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply an input image and mask.

recipes.name: SD 1.5 IP-Adapter / Plus
recipes.description: Select matching SD 1.5 IP-Adapter or Plus weights and CLIP Vision H, then supply an IP-Adapter image.

recipes.name: SD 2.1 512
recipes.description: Supports SD 2.x 512 and compatible layer-count variants. Tiny SD2 Diffusers directories must first be converted into a single-file checkpoint.

recipes.name: SD 2 Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply Init Image and Mask Image.

recipes.name: SD 3 Medium
recipes.description: Checkpoint with CLIP-L, CLIP-G and T5 included.

recipes.name: SDXL
recipes.description: Supports SDXL and compatible reduced-depth checkpoints such as SSD-1B and Segmind Vega.

recipes.name: SDXL ControlNet
recipes.description: Select a compatible SDXL ControlNet and supply a preprocessed control image. Input image and mask are optional for image-to-image or inpainting.

recipes.name: SDXL Inpainting
recipes.description: Select an inpainting checkpoint, then supply Init Image and Mask Image.

recipes.name: SDXL IP-Adapter / Plus
recipes.description: Select matching SDXL ViT-H IP-Adapter or Plus weights and CLIP Vision H, then supply an IP-Adapter image.

recipes.name: SDXL PhotoMaker
recipes.description: Select PhotoMaker v1 and supply identity images. Include the img trigger in the prompt.

recipes.name: SenseNova U1.5
recipes.description: Bundled MoT checkpoint.

recipes.name: Z-Image L2P
recipes.description: Pixel-space L2P checkpoint with Qwen 3 4B; no VAE is needed. Use dimensions divisible by 16.
